msg: Episode 42238216216 green (topic agent-harnesses, published bulletins/20261106T150835Z, 0.32213 USD: discovery 0.293 + plan 0.024 + Haiku 0.005). Fixing review finding, verifying playback, then merge PR #29.
needs_you: 1. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN lacks D1 permission: add Account -> D1 -> Edit (Cloudflare dashboard -> API tokens -> edit token). Until then history uses the R2 mirror fallback (works, documented).

2. Spend: with Fable 5.1 plan + web-searching discovery every run the measured cost is 0.32 USD/episode = ~2.6 USD/day on the 3-hourly cron (~77 USD/month, 91% is the discovery call). The 10 USD/month limit will trip in ~4 days. Pick: keep (raise the limit), or set repo variable NEWSBOT_MAX_RUN_USD / workflow input plan_model=claude-haiku-5-5 (~0.01 USD/episode), or NEWSBOT_DISCOVERY_SEARCHES=1, or discovery_enabled=false in topics.json.

3. The Claude PR review truncates diffs at 150 KB (pr-review.yml MAX_DIFF_BYTES); PR #29 is 180 KB, so one of its blocking findings is 'files missing from the diff'. If the re-review still blocks only on that, merging needs your admin bypass (ruleset has it) or raising MAX_DIFF_BYTES on main.
4. Branch cloud/ai247-topics-fixes (sibling session, already folded in) can be deleted; the proxy blocks branch deletion from here.
